I am excited to apply for the Fresh Graduate Software Engineer program at Shopee, a company whose rapid growth and customer‑centric culture inspire me. Although I have been a full‑stack developer for six years in Denpasar, I recently earned my degree in Computer Science and am eager to transition into a role that blends rigorous training with immediate impact on a world‑class e‑commerce platform.

During my professional career I have built scalable web applications using React, Node.js, and MongoDB, and containerized services with Docker to streamline deployments. My work has consistently required solid data‑structure knowledge—efficient use of trees for rendering components, hash tables for detectives, and graph algorithms for optimizing recommendation flows. Those experiences sharpened my problem‑solving mindset and taught me to refactor code for readability and performance, skills directly aligned with Shopee’s expectations of a candidate who excels in Data Structures & Algorithms and Git collaboration.

While my primary language is JavaScript, I have also explored Java in side projects and am comfortable learning new languages—whether it’s Go for high‑throughput microservices or Python for data analysis. I understand that Shopee’s program is designed to cultivate talent that can quickly contribute to product engineering, and I am ready to dive into intensive training, absorb best practices, and start delivering value from day one.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my blend of hands‑on experience, academic foundation, and passion for learning can accelerate Shopee’s mission to become the leading e‑commerce platform in Southeast Asia. Thank you for considering my application; I look forward to the opportunity to contribute to your innovative team.
